behaviors.behavior: stale mirror content is reported as drift
an in-sync mirror is ok and named in verified
a missing mirror dir (real source) is not_mirrored, counted as drift
an existing-but-empty mirror dir is also not_mirrored, not a generic drift compare
a plugin with no cached version reports mirror=no_source, not double-counted as drift
behaviors.evidence: test_plugin_cache_sync_verdict.py::test_a_plugin_with_no_cached_version_reports_no_source_not_drift PASSED (asserts mirror state, plugins state, and drifted_count==1)

behaviors.behavior: the mirror source is the newest cached version, independent of installed_plugins.json
the mirror's cache basis never triggers the git-fallback basis note on a green run
the WARN line names the drifted mirror plugin and offending file
the OK line names the mirror's own coverage (plugin count, file count)
a mirror-only file (no source counterpart) is cache_only, not drift
behaviors.evidence: test_cache_mirror_compare.py::TestDriftAndOk::test_a_mirror_only_file_is_cache_only_not_drift PASSED; test_a_stale_mirror_is_drift asserts cache_only_count==1 alongside a real diff

behaviors.behavior: orphan markers under the now-gated mirror tree surface in the advisory
ungated is always [] and verified includes mirror now that all three trees are gated
the JSON payload carries the mirror key on every status, including early returns
no_source records do not share mutable state across calls
the shipped CLI (not just pytest) gates a stale mirror and passes a synced one end-to-end
behaviors.evidence: F0.5 surface_verification (surface=cli, tests_run=3) exit_code=0, 3/3 CLI probes passed

surface_verification.detail: The shipped scripts/check_plugin_cache_sync.py CLI driven end-to-end (not pytest, not mocked) against a real repo+cache fixture tree via .shipwright/runs/f05_cli_probe.sh: (1) a stale mirror correctly fails --strict, (2) the --json payload names the mirror finding, (3) syncing the mirror content makes --strict pass again. 3/3 probes passed.
